question: Will [TITLE] become one of the Top 10 shows in the US within 7 days of release?

SHOW_TITLE.reason: [SHOW_TITLE] refers to the name of a television show. The available canonical vocabulary does not include SHOW_TITLE or TV_TITLE, so TITLE is the closest generic content-title placeholder. FILM/MOVIE variants are too specific to movies.
